kind.label: Kind
kind.hint: A solid block stops movement and line of effect, and can be stood on. Liquid softens falls. A pit drops the ground to the region's bottom.

material.label: Material
material.hint: What a solid block is made of, so creatures can be hurled through it. Something solid never breaks.

face.body: Click to ping it on the map. Shift-click to pull everyone's view to it.

damageType.body: Immunity and weakness to {type} change this damage.

bugReport.title: Report a Bug
bugReport.body: Report a bug in a Draw Steel module. It fills in your versions and settings, and points out known fixes as you type.

browseFiles.title: Browse Files
browseFiles.body: Pick an image from your files.

wiki.title: Read More
wiki.body: Opens the {page} page of the wiki, which covers this in more detail.

iconPreview.title: Current Icon
iconPreview.body: The image this setting uses now.

picker.toggleUi: Toggle the rest of the UI
picker.chooseLanding: Choose where {name} lands. Escape to skip.

settings.searchNone: No settings here match that search.
settings.wikiLink: Open the {page} page of the wiki
settings.reloadTooltip: This one only takes full effect once you reload the world.

primaryDirector.name: Primary Director
primaryDirector.hint: The Director whose machine runs the automation for every Draw Steel module, from deaths to the trigger stack and changes made for players. The first Director to load claims it.

requires.installed: {module} is installed but not enabled in this world. This setting does nothing until it is.
requires.missing: {module} is not installed. This setting does nothing until it is.

bugReport.title: New: Report a Bug
bugReport.body: Spotted something wrong with {modules}? Click the bug icon among the chat controls, or Report a Draw Steel Module Bug in the Settings sidebar.
bugReport.extra: It fills in your versions and settings for you, and if what you describe is a known setting or an already fixed bug, it tells you as you type. You can hide the chat icon in CTLib's settings.

blocked.title: Some Draw Steel modules can't turn on
blocked.old: it needs {module} {min} or newer, and this world has {have}.
blocked.missing: it needs the module {module}, which isn't installed.
blocked.fix: Update or install these from Foundry's Setup screen (Add-on Modules, then Update All), then turn {modules} on in Manage Modules.
blocked.toast: Can't turn on: {modules}. CTLib explains what's missing in chat.

bugReport.title: Report a Bug
bugReport.button: Report a Draw Steel Module Bug
bugReport.intro: Describe what went wrong and the report fills in the versions, your other modules and the settings the module uses. Look at the preview to see exactly what is shared; nothing is sent until you open the issue or copy it.
bugReport.whatPlaceholder: What you saw, and what you expected to happen instead.
bugReport.stepsPlaceholder:
1. Start a combat with a squad of minions
2. Push one into a wall
3. ...
bugReport.name: Preferred name or Discord username?
bugReport.nameOptional: (optional, only if you'd like credit or a reply)
bugReport.namePlaceholder: Leave it empty to stay anonymous.
bugReport.includeErrors: Include recent errors from the browser console ({count})
bugReport.preview: Preview: exactly what the report contains
bugReport.copied: Bug report copied. Paste it wherever you're reporting the bug.
bugReport.tooLong: The report is too long to fill in on GitHub, so the full version is on your clipboard. Paste it into the issue below the description.
bugReport.pasteBelow: _The full diagnostics are too long to fill in here. They are on your clipboard: paste them below this line._
bugReport.noGithub: {module} has no GitHub issues page, so the report was copied to your clipboard instead.
bugReport.suggestions: This might already have an answer:
bugReport.settingHint: Shows a bug icon among the chat controls that opens the bug report. The button in the Settings sidebar stays either way.
